kages/shell@1.summary: App frame with sidebar, header and main regions.

kages/nav@1.summary: Collapsible navigation list; one active item.

kages/select@1.summary: Pick exactly one value from a short list.

kages/stack@1.summary: Lay children out in a row, column or grid.

kages/text@1.summary: A run of text in one type style.

kages/table@1.summary: Rows of records under typed columns.

kages/page@1.summary: Sidebar-free page with optional header and footer and a reading, wide or full canvas.

kages/section@1.summary: Editorial or hero region with optional title, prose, content and actions.

kages/grid@1.summary: Responsive equal-column grid that fits its container and stacks on narrow canvases.

columns.description: Maximum column count, a positive integer. Fewer columns render when needed to fit the canvas.

kages/split@1.summary: Two flowing panes with a chosen ratio, stacked in source order on narrow canvases.

kages/image@1.summary: Accessible image with a semantic aspect ratio, fit and optional caption.

kages/code@1.summary: Literal source code or structured text; displayed, never executed.

kages/divider@1.summary: Semantic separator between flowing content regions.

kages/textarea@1.summary: Labelled multiline input with public value and change events.

kages/slider@1.summary: Labelled numeric range input with a live value.

kages/checkbox@1.summary: Labelled boolean choice with public checked state.

kages/bar-chart@1.summary: Responsive horizontal bars with accessible labels and numeric values.

kages/composition@1.summary: Reusable document-local composition with typed inputs and a public value output.

kages/link@1.summary: Accessible passive link; executable URL schemes are refused.

kages/rich-text@1.summary: Structured headings, paragraphs, quotes, lists and inline emphasis without raw HTML.

kages/text-field@1.summary: Named text, email or URL field with native form validation.

kages/number-input@1.summary: Named numeric field with min/max/step validation; empty value is null.

kages/date-input@1.summary: Named date field with native picker and ISO date output.

kages/choice@1.summary: Named radio group with native keyboard navigation and a public selection.

kages/multiselect@1.summary: Named multiple selection with native keyboard support and array output.

kages/form@1.summary: Native validated form; submit emits named field values as strings or arrays of strings.

kages/scene@1.summary: Responsive vector scene assembled from rect/circle/line/path/text geometry and token colors.

kages/diagram@1.summary: Node and edge diagram with automatic placement or explicit coordinates.

kages/line-chart@1.summary: Responsive numeric X/Y line chart with an accessible data table.

kages/scatter-chart@1.summary: Responsive numeric X/Y scatter plot with an accessible data table.

kages/area-chart@1.summary: Responsive filled area chart of numeric X/Y data with an accessible data table.

kages/donut-chart@1.summary: Part-to-whole ring chart with a legend, percentages and an accessible data table.

kages/gauge@1.summary: Single value on a half-ring scale between a minimum and maximum.

kages/sparkline@1.summary: Tiny inline trend line for a series of numbers; sits next to a stat or in a table cell.

kages/heatmap@1.summary: Row by column matrix whose cell shading shows magnitude, with every value readable as text.

kages/alert@1.summary: Inline callout for information, success, warning or danger with an optional title and content.

kages/accordion@1.summary: Stack of headings that each reveal a panel; one open at a time with a public value.

kages/stepper@1.summary: Ordered progress through named steps; optionally clickable, with the current step public.

kages/timeline@1.summary: Chronological list of events with optional times, descriptions and tone.

kages/modal@1.summary: Dialog layered over the artifact; opened and closed by commands, Escape or the close button.

kages/switch@1.summary: Labelled on/off toggle with a public checked state.

kages/combobox@1.summary: Type-to-filter single choice with a keyboard listbox; the value is always one of the options.

kages/tree@1.summary: Expandable hierarchy with keyboard navigation and a selected node id.

kages/data-grid@1.summary: Sortable, filterable, paged table whose rows can be selected.

kages/kanban@1.summary: Columns of cards that move between columns with buttons; the moved board is public.

kages/calendar@1.summary: Month grid with event dots, month navigation and a selected ISO date.

kages/carousel@1.summary: One slide at a time with previous/next, dots and arrow keys; the slide index is public.

kages/markdown@1.summary: Markdown subset (headings, lists, quotes, code, emphasis, links, $math$) rendered as elements, never HTML.

kages/math@1.summary: TeX math (fractions, roots, scripts and limits, matrices, cases, accents, stretchy delimiters, Greek and symbols) rendered as accessible elements.

kages/combo-chart@1.summary: Grouped bars and lines on one shared axis for categories, with a legend and data table.

kages/stacked-bar-chart@1.summary: Stacked columns of series per category, absolute or normalised to 100%.

kages/funnel-chart@1.summary: Ordered stages narrowing by value, with the share of the first stage; stages can be selected.

kages/treemap@1.summary: Rectangles sized by value, packed to near-square, with optional selection.

kages/sankey@1.summary: Flows between nodes in left-to-right layers, with widths proportional to value.

kages/map@1.summary: Choropleth of GeoJSON Polygon/MultiPolygon regions shaded by value, with optional selection.
